verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server whose tools let AI agents interact with the Stripe API. That gives a first-party route to operating the product through natural-language commands, but only via an external AI client. The evidence does not show a built-in natural-language interface or which crypto and stablecoin operations the MCP tools cover. Machine payments (agents paying for APIs) is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documented MCP tool coverage of stablecoin payments, payouts and onramp, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
